info.title: Nano Hosted Thread API
info.description: Provider-neutral localhost API for creating, operating, observing, and continuing ordinary Nano-hosted Codex and Claude sessions plus experimental Grok Build sessions. Start with GET /api/v1/capabilities for the compact agent workflow. While Nano restarts, a write may be answered 503 with error code restarting and Retry-After: 10. Nothing was recorded; send the same request again after that delay, keeping the endpoint's own idempotency key where it has one (clientActionId, clientMessageId or clientRegistrationId).

servers.description: The same Nano origin that served this document

tags.name: Hosted threads
tags.description: Ordinary Codex and Claude sessions, plus experimental Grok Build sessions, with durable Nano identity.

tags.name: Conversation

tags.name: Browser validation

tags.name: Historical search

tags.name: Identity

x-nano-agent-quickstart: Create a hosted thread with your own thread id as invokerThreadRef and retain hostedThreadId.
Submit each agent prompt with a stable clientActionId and your resolvable senderThreadRef; retain operationId.
Return control to the user after submission so the parent agent remains conversational.
Check operation state in a later parent turn; long-poll only for an explicit foreground wait.
Answer pending interactions, then detach again or explicitly continue waiting.
Use the messages-default conversation SSE only when live transcript activity is useful.

get.summary: Discover the Nano agent API
get.description: Returns the same compact capability guide as /api/v1/capabilities and links this OpenAPI document.

get.summary: Read the compact agent capability guide
get.description: The recommended first request for an agent. Describes providers, identities, operations, views, states, idempotency, and a safe quickstart sequence.

get.summary: Read the OpenAPI 3.1 contract
Resolve a display name, native thread id, or hosted thread id
get.description: Takes any one of a thread's Nano display name, provider-native id, or hosted nht_* id and returns the current displayName, nativeThreadId, nativeThreadIdProvisional, hostedThreadId, and provider. Duplicate display names resolve to the most recently updated thread; matchCount reports how many matched. Rename, resume, and Claude respawn keep the mapping current. Unknown refs return 404. Results are not stored.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Display name, native thread id, or hosted thread id.

nativeThreadIdProvisional.description: True when nativeThreadId is a provider transport stand-in, such as Claude's cs_ id, rather than a resumable provider UUID.

404.description: not_found; no thread matches that identity.

get.summary: Resolve an exact browser thread reference
get.description: Accepts only a provider-native UUID, nht_* hosted id, or exact nth_* catalog compatibility id. A live hosted continuation resolves to route live; a detached or retired record resolves to its exact historical catalog row. Unresolved outcomes are typed and never use prefix matching. Results are not stored.

200.description: Resolved target or typed unresolved outcome.

400.description: invalid_thread_reference; truncated or malformed references are rejected.

get.summary: Search ready historical conversation messages
get.description: q and mode are required. literal is case-sensitive exact-character matching with canonical-text verification after trigram candidates; terms requires every Unicode word token and never exposes raw FTS syntax. group defaults to message. since/until are half-open message timestamp bounds. A cursor binds the complete normalized query and mode revision.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: One to 4096 valid UTF-8 bytes (the bound is bytes, not Unicode characters).

200.description: Verified historical message matches with mode, group, searchRevision, items, and optional nextCursor.

409.description: search_changed: restart paging from the first page.

503.description: search_index_building: requested mode is not complete; status contains the bounded mode state.

get.summary: Read historical search mode status

200.description: Corpus/tokenizer versions, state, checkpoints, counts, revision, timestamps, and bounded error for literal and terms modes.

get.summary: Read Nano's newest restart records
get.description: One record per Nano process start, newest first; this process's own while its boot is still settling (complete false). Content-free: ids, reason codes and millisecond offsets from started_at. Per restart: http_open_ms, boot_loop_ms, visible_live_ms and all_live_ms (null while a counted thread is pending or failed), visible_settled_ms and all_settled_ms, counts, and per-provider p50/p95/max of each stage. With threads=1, each stored thread's picked, lock, registered, attached, live and failed offsets, its sidebar tier, visibility and failure reason. Also appended to <data-dir>/restarts.jsonl next to deploys.jsonl; see docs/restart-tracking.md.

get.summary: Read Nano process state and optional operator monitoring records
get.description: Threads Nano holds in memory, the turns it shows as running, when an operator tool last wrote a host snapshot (stale after 4 minutes), the newest 5 restart records without threads, newest first, this process's own while its boot settles (restarts; see listRestarts), and the newest 50 alert changes from alerts.jsonl, oldest first. Each alert line records a row starting (firing true) or clearing (firing false). Also Nano's own timing of the API calls it served, per closed minute and operation, for the last 10 minutes, and the live streams open now. About 25 KB, mostly the ten minutes of call timing and the alerts. Operator tools can read this endpoint instead of the full session list.

ingest.description: Attached-file ingestion now, null when the thread catalog is unavailable. watch: mode (kqueue, disabled by -no-watch, or unavailable with error) and ownership counts (paths, files, directories waiting for absent files, waiting, failed, pathBytes, loopFailed); attachments (every live attachment), unresolvedAttachments (those holding no file, counted by a fixed reason such as awaiting native identity or provisional identity) and heldSources, of which outsideSources counts the sessions Nano did not start that discovery holds (at most 256; the least recently saved gives way past that); queued and inFlight sources; oldestPendingMs (null when none, includes running work); unreadBytes and partialLineBytes measured at each held file's last observed size (no stat is taken to report them; a partial final line is held in parser continuation, not unread); unobservedSources; stalledSources (dirty work with neither read nor committed progress for 30 seconds); failingSources and maxConsecutiveFailures; manualRefreshMs (null unless an explicit recovery walk is running) and manualRefreshQueued; publicationBacklog and publicationInFlight; heap (allocatedBytes, inUseBytes, reservedBytes); and minutes, the closed minutes of the last 10, oldest first, each with providers (passes, unchanged, missing, bytesRead, committedBytes and committedRecords for successful appends, rebuilds and rebuildBytes, parserDiagnostics, errors by kind read, apply, store or identity_retry, and stages: append or rebuild queue, prepare and save, and publish wait and run, each with count, approximate medianMs and p95Ms from fixed buckets, and maxMs) and recovery, the explicit full walks that ended in the minute. Event counts are not reported: a file event is not a write or a row.

newestSnapshotAt.description: Null when no operator tool has written a host snapshot.

delivery.description: The newest operator-supplied snapshot's delivery block, returned as recorded. Null when no delivery block is available.

source.description: Operator-supplied tool identifier, or nano for built-in snapshot freshness alerts.

requests.description: Closed minutes only, oldest first; a minute is served once it has ended, so a reader that keeps the minutes newer than its last read neither skips nor repeats one.

routes.description: Keyed by the route's operation name.

calls.description: Calls that ended in this minute, streams excluded. A handler that panics before answering counts as a 500.

medianMs.description: The middle call's duration; the upper middle of an even count.

failed.description: Answers of 400 and above, keyed by status code; a 304 cache revalidation is not a failure.

medianBytes.description: Response body bytes of the middle call (the upper middle of an even count).

maxBytes.description: Response body bytes of the largest call.

firstDataMedianMs.description: For streams: time from the request to the stream's first flush that carried data (SSE comment lines are not data); the initial tail of a thread's live stream. Middle of the minute's streams.

firstDataMaxMs.description: For streams: the slowest time to first data.

firstDataMedianBytes.description: For streams: body bytes written up to the first data flush, middle of the minute's streams.

firstDataMaxBytes.description: For streams: the largest bytes to first data.

streamsOpen.description: Live text/event-stream responses open now, by operation.

warmStreams.description: Each open warm stream (one per browser page; it carries saved rows of threads not on screen), oldest first: when it opened, the threads it carries now, the page reads its threads took, the bytes it sent, and the tails among them (the connect burst, then one per thread joining, rebuild or gap).

restarts.description: The newest 5 restart records without threads, newest first (listRestarts).

deploys.description: The newest 5 deploy records host deployment tooling wrote to deploys.jsonl, newest first. A deploy's restart is the first restart with the same stamp whose started_at is at or after the deploy's restarted_at.

get.summary: List the latest ingestion receipt of each watched native file
get.description: One receipt per native file an attachment holds, newest first, replaced only when ingestion committed new transcript bytes or rebuilt it. Each names the source and projection (provider, threadId, nativeThreadId, sourceId, sourceGeneration, projectionKey, mode append or rebuild), the committed range (startReadOffset, endReadOffset, completeOffset), the file size the pass observed, complete source records committed, UTC instants for the first unserved hint, preparation start and end, save, and the transcript-change callback start and end, and the monotonic durations between them. A callback can cover several commits. No transcript text and no per-event history are kept.

get.summary: Fleet per-thread token-usage totals
get.description: Sums per-turn envelope columns from the thread_turn_usage view. No cross-provider grand total. Envelope columns are NULL when usage_contract is not 1.

200.description: Per-thread envelope sums plus turnsTotal and turnsWithUsage.

get.summary: Per-turn token usage joined to that turn's messages
get.description: Returns provider-native per-turn usage with the user and assistant messages in each turn so a spike maps to what happened. id is the same catalog resolver as transcript.

200.description: Turns with envelope usage and message linkage.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: Catalog id, hosted id, or provider-native thread id.

get.summary: Read a bounded window of the saved transcript
List hosted threads
get.description: Lists ordinary human-created and API-created hosted threads. Closed records are excluded.

post.summary: Create a hosted thread
post.description: Creates an ordinary Codex, Claude, or Grok Build session. invokerThreadRef is required for agent attribution and cross-provider UI nesting. subscriptions independently chooses completion inbox and prompt delivery; inbox defaults to send and prompt defaults to none. clientSessionId is optional creation idempotency; reuse it only with identical parameters. mode must be start. Codex and Claude threads receive a server-injected 'Nano hosted identity' block (hostedThreadId, provider, apiOrigin) in trusted context at start; Grok threads do not (no non-user-role seam).

202.description: An idempotently existing hosted thread is still being created.

get.summary: Read canonical hosted-thread metadata and attachment state

200.description: Canonical current state keyed by hostedThreadId.

get.summary: Read whether a thread can safely receive a prompt now
get.description: Hard facts only (sample-task stage 0): busy when a turn is in flight or prompts are queued; awaiting-human when a permission/input card is open; unreachable when detached, exited, or unknown; otherwise available. The last human-message time remains diagnostic but elapsed time does not decide ownership. Read-only; no heuristics; turnActive can under-report for notification-started turns.

200.description: Availability state, reasons, and the facts behind it.

post.summary: Store durable inbox-only mail for one hosted thread
post.description: Stores mail without creating, queueing, or delivering a prompt turn. Exactly one sender identity is required: senderThreadRef (a hosted thread, snapshotted) or operator:true (stored as the generic Operator identity). dispositionFeedback is opt-in and defaults false. clientMessageId is idempotent per sender; exact replay returns 200 and conflicting content returns 409.

get.summary: List a hosted thread's pins newest first
get.description: Read backward until you find the topic you want to resume. The list covers pins written under this hosted thread plus pins anchored in any native transcript it has claimed, so provider replacement or reattachment never strands them. There is no status filter: pins have no lifecycle.

post.summary: Append a pin anchored to one transcript message
post.description: Append-only and ceremony-free: no approval, status, expiry, or cleanup. Omit itemId to anchor the thread's latest indexed user or agent message ("pin this"); pass itemId to anchor an exact earlier message (find it with GET .../pins/candidates). Nothing is injected into any turn.

200.description: Idempotent retry of the same clientActionId; returns the original pin.

404.description: Unknown hosted thread, or anchor_not_found: itemId is not a user or agent message in this thread.

get.summary: List recent messages with item ids to anchor
get.description: Newest-first user and agent messages from the hosted thread's current native transcript, each with the itemId to pass when appending a pin.

parameters.name: pinId
parameters.description: Pin id (pin_*) from a list or create response.

get.summary: Read one pin

parameters.name: pinId
parameters.description: Pin id (pin_*) from a list or create response.

get.summary: Read a pin's anchored message with the complete turns before it
get.description: Returns up to `turns` whole preceding turns plus the anchor's own turn, cut at the anchored message, with stable turn and item ids. hasEarlierHistory reports whether any older turn exists; earlierHistoryUrl pages further back through the transcript API. A response over the transcript byte budget first downgrades full bodies to previews, then drops the oldest turns (trimmedForSize). A broken anchor returns 404 pin_anchor_missing or pin_thread_not_indexed with the unchanged pin in error.details.pin.

get.summary: Observe pin accumulation, retrieval, and broken anchors
get.description: Observational only. Reports pin counts per thread, list and context-read counters, newest-first read rank and list scan depth, and anchors that no longer resolve. It never modifies, prunes, or validates pins.

get.summary: Read a hosted thread's own durable inbox
get.description: actorThreadRef must resolve to the same hosted thread. Returned unread rows become seen unless peek=true. status=seen directly finds read but undispositioned mail.

get.summary: Read mail sent by one hosted thread

200.description: Messages in durable creation order with current recipient status.

get.summary: Read one durable message and its event history

post.summary: Edit an operator-authored message while it is still unread
post.description: Only operator-authored mail, and only while unread: once the recipient has read the message it is frozen and a follow-up message is the correction path. The previous content is preserved as an 'edited' event.

409.description: The message is not operator-authored or has already been read.

get.summary: Operator cross-thread mail listing
get.description: Every recipient's mail, newest first by durable global order. Read-only: never marks mail seen. Page backward with before=nextBefore from the prior response. The summary aggregates all mail: total, unread, and seen (read but undispositioned).

schema.description: Return messages with global order strictly below this; 0 or absent starts at the newest.

200.description: Messages in descending global order plus aggregate counts.

post.summary: Disposition mail as acted, declined, or deferred
post.description: Only the recipient may disposition. Deferred may later become acted or declined. When the message opted into dispositionFeedback, each accepted transition atomically creates one Nano feedback message in the original sender's inbox; system feedback does not recurse.

200.description: Updated message plus its opt-in sender feedback message, if any.

get.summary: List explicit heartbeat attachments
get.description: Advanced default-off surface. Returns durable attachment configuration and lifecycle/pause state.

200.description: Attachment list and global enabled state.

post.summary: Attach one hosted thread to heartbeat
post.description: Creates one audited attachment. The scheduler acts on wall-clock minutes, with no catch-up for minutes missed while Nano was down. Backoff raises effective cadence from 1 to 2 and then 5 minutes after each ten consecutive wakes without a human message or explicit resume.

offsetMinutes.description: Minute offset within the cadence; normalized modulo cadenceMinutes.

prompt.description: Required unless the selected repository template has a default prompt.

get.summary: List Git-backed pre-ping templates
get.description: Templates are reviewed source material editable only by the operator through the repository. Selecting one on an attachment creates an independent immutable copy; later template edits never change that attachment.

200.description: Template metadata, defaults, and immutable content revision.

get.summary: List immutable attachment script copies
get.description: Scripts are read-only through the API. New copies are created only by selecting a repository template on an attachment.

200.description: Immutable attachment script identities and revision numbers.

get.summary: Read one owned script revision

200.description: Script identity plus requested immutable revision.

get.summary: Read one heartbeat attachment

patch.summary: Update cadence, offset, prompt, or pre-ping template
patch.description: Records one append-only updated event. Set prePing to null to clear it; selecting a template creates a new immutable attachment copy. Updating clears a pre-ping failure latch.

post.summary: Pause or resume one attachment
post.description: Every pause or resume requires and records actor, reason, and timestamp. Resume resets consecutive-wake backoff.

get.summary: Read bounded persisted heartbeat decisions
get.description: Includes delivered wakes, silent skips, pre-ping evidence, delivery failures, and provider-reported token usage or an explicit unavailable marker. Decision-only skip rows expire after 30 days; deliveries and failures remain. It never contains script output, prompt text, inbox contents, transcript excerpts, or chain of thought.

get.summary: Read the durable invocation family and operation identifiers
get.description: Reads immutable hosted-thread invoker edges and durable operation records. It includes detached and exited descendants when available. It is read-only and never closes, detaches, deletes, or wakes a thread.

200.description: Root identity, ancestors, and root/descendant members with their operation IDs.

get.summary: Preview the current mutable thread tree
get.description: Returns the exact assignment-first tree resolver used by POST, including members not loaded in the browser's current catalog window. It changes no thread. Because relationships can change after this response, POST resolves the tree again under the relationship lock.

200.description: Current tree members, depths, working state, and stars.

post.summary: Close the current mutable thread tree
post.description: Closes the referenced visible root and every recursive descendant in Nano's current assignment-first sidebar tree. A mutable related-thread assignment wins over immutable invoker lineage, so a thread moved under another parent is not closed with its former parent. Resumed hosted aliases are collapsed to the current visible conversation owner. Child creation, relationship moves, and close operations serialize with tree resolution so a descendant cannot escape the snapshot. Durable hosted records and transcripts survive. Every member that closes loses its star, including a member that was already closed; a member that fails to close keeps its star. 207 exposes per-member partial failure.

200.description: Every member is exited or was already exited.

207.description: One or more members did not fully close; inspect each member result.

get.summary: Read bounded immutable metadata evidence after an event cursor

200.description: A bounded, deterministically ordered event page with nextCursor.

get.summary: Read durable permission requests and their decisions
get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated audit trail for permission interactions. Request bodies and command text are not exposed; requestSummary contains bounded structural details and requestSha256 fingerprints the received request.

200.description: A bounded permission audit page in event order.

get.summary: Read revision hints; refetch current metadata when requested

put.summary: Replace or clear an execution assignment
put.description: clientActionId is idempotent for this hosted thread. The full assignment, including its optional mutable visual relationship, is replaced as one immutable metadata event. A null assignment clears only current state; prior events, operation snapshots, and immutable invocation lineage remain. Self-links and relationship cycles are rejected.

200.description: Mutation result with the committed assignmentEventId, including clears and stable retries.

500.description: Assignment storage failed after request validation.

get.summary: Resolve and read a hosted thread
get.description: threadRef accepts hostedThreadId, clientSessionId, the current nanoSessionId, or a known nativeThreadId. Retain hostedThreadId across restarts.

200.description: The durable control record joined to current runtime state.

delete.summary: Destroy a hosted thread's durable record
delete.description: Closes the attachment if live, then erases the durable hosted-thread record, its operations, and any queued prompts. Behavior change 2026-08-06: DELETE previously acted as close; callers meaning 'end the attachment, keep the record' must use POST {threadRef}/close.

post.summary: Close a hosted thread, keeping its durable record
post.description: Ends the attachment, settles non-terminal operations as interrupted (including on an already-detached thread), forgets the boot-reattach attachment record, drops queued prompts, and removes the thread's star. The durable hosted-thread record survives with status exited. Claude closure requires acknowledgement from the exact shim process; errors, missing identity and unconfirmed not-found replies preserve the attachment and queued prompts. No attach, replay or replacement process is started by close.

put.summary: Set a hosted thread's presentation mode
put.description: Flips an existing hosted thread between shared and background. control.sqlite is the durable authority; the live session, execution cache, and runtime overlay synchronize immediately, so a backgrounded thread leaves the visible sidebar (behind the Background agents disclosure) and the recency-based keyboard navigation. Same-value writes are idempotent and revision-neutral. The mode must be explicit; omitting it is an error, never a reset to shared.

put.summary: Set a hosted thread's completion notifications
put.description: Replaces both explicit completion subscription choices after creation. The canonical control store persists them and the next completion uses them without a restart. Same-value writes are revision-neutral. Already-admitted notices remain queued.

400.description: Missing or invalid inbox or prompt choice.

put.summary: Set a hosted thread's operational sidebar placement
put.description: Sets whether an unassigned hosted thread follows its immutable invoker in the sidebar/Explorer tree or stands alone at the top level. A current worker or auditor assignment remains authoritative. Clearing that assignment restores this saved placement. Invocation lineage and the immutable family endpoint are unchanged. Same-value writes are idempotent and revision-neutral.

post.summary: Non-destructively release the live attachment
post.description: Releases Nano's live attachment while every durable record survives; the thread reports detached, and boot reattach or resume restores it. Refused with 409 while any operation lacks terminal evidence — detach never invents turn evidence.

409.description: Operations are still open; interrupt or cancel them, or use close.

get.summary: Read the normalized conversation snapshot
get.description: Reads the saved transcript: the provider's file as the catalog indexes it. Defaults to the messages allowlist and the newest 20 rows visible in that view; unsaved live text never appears. Pass nextBeforeCursor as before to read older saved rows. Runtime and pending-interaction metadata remain present in both views.

200.description: A bounded window of saved rows with an older-page cursor, plus the status epoch and revision.

409.description: The thread is detached, or the saved transcript changed under the cursor (transcript_changed). Reload without before.

get.summary: Watch a conversation's status and saved-row changes
get.description: SSE data frames contain LiveProjectionUpdate JSON. The first frame is a snapshot of the newest saved rows with status. Later frames carry status and pending-question changes newer than that snapshot, and a rows.changed hint whenever the saved rows change; read the conversation again for the rows. The stream ends when the status epoch changes, so a reconnect starts from a fresh snapshot. Heartbeats are SSE comments.

schema.description: Each data line is a JSON-encoded LiveProjectionUpdate.

post.summary: Submit one prompt idempotently
post.description: Returns a durable operation handle. Agent-origin requests require a complete, resolvable senderThreadRef and reject the reserved nano: prefix. System-origin requests omit senderThreadRef and require nano:. Invalid attribution is rejected before any operation, queue entry, or provider delivery. By default a starting thread durably queues the prompt, and a Codex thread whose turn is working takes it into that turn; other busy threads queue it. Set nextTurn=true to hold the prompt until the running turn ends. Set requireIdle=true to atomically reject unless the target is ready, idle, and has no older queued work; rejection creates no operation or queue artifact. Reusing clientActionId requires the same prompt, requireIdle and nextTurn policy.

202.description: The newly accepted operation. Its status is queued while waiting for a starting or busy thread, or delivery_pending while crossing the provider-delivery boundary.

get.summary: Read terminal turns after a durable cursor
get.description: Returns completed, failed, and interrupted turn facts in publication order, including provider token counters when available. Persist nextCursor and pass it as after; an empty cursor starts at the oldest retained terminal turn.

200.description: The next ordered page of completion facts.

post.summary: Preview or repair immutable hosted-thread creation names
post.description: Accepts an explicit reviewed record set. Preview is read-only and returns identity-checked records plus a fingerprint. Apply requires that exact fingerprint, reserves the canonical store writer, creates a fresh backup, repeats the preview, and records every missing creation name in one transaction. Existing matching facts are idempotent; conflicting facts or changed hosted/native identities refuse. Creation names seed an empty display-name slot at every bind but never overwrite an operator rename. Nothing invokes this operation automatically.

schema.description: At least one entry across records and unrecoverable is required.

expectedFingerprint.description: Required for apply; copy preview.fingerprint from the reviewed preview.

unrecoverable.description: Included in the fingerprint and never mutated.

200.description: Read-only preview or applied receipt with normalized repair records, the classified no-recoverable-name list, missing/existing counts, fingerprint, and on apply the backup path and SHA256.

409.description: Unknown or changed identity, conflicting creation fact, stale fingerprint, backup failure, or rolled-back transaction.

post.summary: Preview or expire old delivered prompts that exact identity never settled
post.description: Candidates are accepted or uncertain prompts submitted before a cutoff at least 24 hours old, with no dispatch claim, in threads whose live session shows no turn running or restoring and no delivery in flight; that is checked at the preview and again just before each thread's expiry, so a turn starting in between is not excluded. Preview is read-only and returns the cutoff, counts by provider and state, and a fingerprint. Apply requires that cutoff, that fingerprint and a clientActionId; it backs up the prompt store, runs exact-identity settlement for each candidate thread first (proven prompts become confirmed), then marks the rest expired: not shown and not claimed delivered, with their records and text kept. Expired is terminal. A live pane already showing such a row keeps it until the thread's next attach, restart or repair. Nothing is deleted, and nothing invokes this operation automatically.

clientActionId.description: Required for apply; recorded in the receipt and the server log.

200.description: Preview, or applied receipt with the backup path and settled, expired and unchanged counts. Counts only; no prompt text.

409.description: Prompt store unavailable, prompts changed since the preview, or backup failure.

post.summary: Preview or retire duplicate hosted records with a current surviving owner
post.description: Derives retired records from canonical native claims. Preview returns every deleted row, lineage/outbox reference and replacement owner, counts, and an exact-set fingerprint. Apply requires that fingerprint and an explicit repoint/delete outbox disposition; expectedCounts is an optional extra guard. It reserves the server writer through fresh store backup and one transaction, verifies all table contents against the preview, and proves surviving identities through the canonical identity resolver before commit. Any failure rolls back. Execution and outbox caches change only after commit. No restart, provider action, legacy-store write, name change or star change. Receipts contain full row values, which can include prompt text. Save the receipt; retries after success refuse the stale fingerprint.

expectedFingerprint.description: Required for apply; copy preview.fingerprint from the matching preview.

200.description: Preview or applied receipt: ok, applied, preview (records, deleteRows by table, lineage, outbox, counts, fingerprint), before/after counts for every table, backupPath, backupSha256, and resolutions for the surviving native owners. after and resolutions prove committed apply only.

409.description: Refused or rolled-back operation. Returns the available preview and backup evidence with ok=false, applied=false and an error; no after counts or successful resolver proof.

get.summary: Read many turn operations at once
get.description: Returns each requested operation's current view. Ids the store has pruned or never held come back as {id, missing: true} — one stale id never fails the batch. At most 64 ids per request.

200.description: One item per requested id, in request order.

400.description: ids missing, empty, or more than 64.

get.summary: Pull semantic operation transitions since a bookmark
get.description: One call answers 'did any of my workers change state'. The feed is an in-memory, loss-tolerant ring of semantic status transitions behind an epoch.seq bookmark; a Nano restart mints a fresh epoch. resnapshot: true (no_bookmark, unknown_bookmark, bookmark_expired) means re-read retained operations via bulk status, keep the returned bookmark, and continue. waitMs is explicit foreground long-polling; a timeout returns an empty page and changes no provider state.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Bookmark from the previous response. Empty forces resnapshot with a fresh bookmark.

parameters.name: invoker
parameters.description: Optional thread reference; only transitions of operations whose thread this invoker created are returned. Unresolvable references are a 400.

parameters.name: waitMs
parameters.description: Bounded long-poll for the first matching transition.

200.description: Transitions after the bookmark plus the next bookmark.

400.description: The invoker reference does not resolve to a hosted thread.

get.summary: Read or long-poll one turn operation
get.description: Without waitMs, returns current state immediately and is the recommended check from a later parent turn. With afterRevision and waitMs, waits until the operation revision advances or the bounded wait expires; use that mode only for an explicit foreground wait because it keeps the caller's current turn occupied. A caller timeout never changes provider state. Stop automatic waiting on terminal=true or status=delivery_unknown.

delete.description: Cancels the prompt only while status is queued and before provider delivery begins. The returned operation is terminal with status interrupted. Once delivery starts, use the hosted-thread interrupt endpoint instead.

200.description: The queued prompt was canceled before provider delivery.

post.summary: Answer a pending interaction
post.description: Answers one pending question, approval, or elicitation. Continue polling the same turn operation afterward.

200.description: The interaction was claimed and answered.

get.summary: Read the current active sidebar graph
get.description: Returns one complete, current active-thread dataset from Nano's process-local materialized sidebar: attached, detached, tmux-pane-live, working/needs_you, starred, required structural ancestors, and active related descendants. Fleet labels are idle, needs_you, or working. Rows Nano holds copy their session's lifecycle label (runtime.threadStatus); inferred history rows carry watched=true, and an unanswered prompt reads working only while its saved file moved in the last 30 minutes. Ordinary historical rows are excluded. The response includes historicalCount, per-parent historical descendant counts, canonical hierarchy, descendant activity rollups, normalized sort primitives, and the materialization revision. It never includes transcript items. Cache-Control is private, no-store. Subsequent row/removal/root deltas use the sidebar event on /api/v1/thread-index/events.

parameters.name: updatedFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive last-activity bound for the eligible catalog window. Defaults to now minus 30 days. Attached, detached, pane-live, starred, and required-ancestor rows are rescued outside this window.

503.description: catalog_unavailable: the thread catalog is not ready.

get.summary: Page inactive descendants of one sidebar parent
get.description: Resolves {id} through the same canonical graph as the active sidebar and returns only inactive descendants at every depth that were excluded from the active response. Ordered by updatedAt desc, id desc, with 100-row cursor paging. Rows carry the same server hierarchy, historical-descendant counts, and sort primitives. Never includes transcripts.

400.description: invalid_cursor: the history cursor is malformed.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: Catalog id (nth_*), native UUID, or hosted id (nht_*).

put.summary: Star or unstar a catalog thread
put.description: Sets the operator pin overlay used by the sidebar Starred section. Truth lives in a sibling SQLite file keyed by (provider, native_thread_id). Listings and GET /api/v1/sidebar/threads overlay the current value at read time.

200.description: The catalog thread with starred stamped.

400.description: Body must be {"starred": true} or {"starred": false}.

409.description: star_identity_missing: the thread has no provider-native id yet.

post.summary: Request an on-demand saved-versus-browser transcript audit
post.description: Pins one bounded SQLite transcript snapshot and asks the exact tabId/paneId browser surface to inspect its mounted DOM. Only user and assistant messages are checked; tools and reasoning are outside the audit scope. The request is short-lived and stores no transcript bodies.

200.description: The pending or already-completed idempotent audit request.

409.description: The clientActionId was already used with different request fields.

429.description: The bounded pending-audit concurrency cap was reached.

503.description: Transcript audit or catalog service unavailable.

get.summary: Read one transcript audit result
get.description: Returns pending until the exact pane responds. A missing browser capture expires as inconclusive; match applies only to the reported displayed range and scopes.

get.summary: Read the pinned bounded reference for a browser capture
get.description: Browser-internal claim step. Returns transient saved bodies for presentation comparison, with no-store caching. A changed projection fails inconclusive rather than silently moving the reference.

409.description: The audit finished or its pinned saved projection changed.

post.summary: Publish one content-free browser audit result
post.description: Browser-internal completion step. The browser supplies its pane-owned catalog or provider-native reference; Nano resolves it independently and requires the pinned catalog thread. Hosted and Nano session ids are not transcript-audit aliases. Nano also verifies tab, pane, visibility, build, time, scopes, and pinned reference identity. Stored differences contain identities, hashes, lengths and counts, never transcript bodies.

get.summary: List operator feedback notes newest first
get.description: Each note keeps the operator's text, the thread, the serving build and the tab's bundle, the view, and the pane state. Lists omit the evidence; read one note for it.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: A hosted or native thread id.

post.summary: Save an operator feedback note with the evidence of the moment
post.description: The browser first sends its whole retained diagnostic ring to /api/v1/browser-diagnostics, and does not save the note if that fails. Nano then stores a copy of that tab's events for the thread with the note, so a restart cannot erase them. Saving a note notifies no agent. A retried clientActionId returns the original note.

bootId.description: The bootId the diagnostics upload returned; a save after a later restart is refused.

200.description: A retry of an existing note.

201.description: The saved note, without its evidence.

409.description: client_action_reused: the clientActionId belongs to a different note; evidence_lost: Nano restarted after the upload, so the browser must upload and save again.

get.summary: Read one feedback note with its evidence

200.description: The note, including events: the content-free browser diagnostic events captured at save time.

get.summary: Read browser validations and durable duplicate incidents
get.description: Returns the latest content-free intended-versus-mounted row comparisons, meaningful-change history, and durable duplicate fingerprints. Validation rows are in-memory browser evidence. Duplicate incidents survive restart.

200.description: Latest validations, meaningful history, and durable duplicate incidents.

post.summary: Publish one content-free mounted-row observation
post.description: Accepts only row identities and state. Nano independently derives duplicate raw render keys and semantic message IDs. A duplicate observation is committed durably before acceptance; the incident remains available for later inspection.

200.description: Observation accepted, with the durable incident when duplicates were found.

503.description: A duplicate was observed but durable incident storage was unavailable.

post.summary: Request interruption of the current turn
post.description: Returns interrupted=false when no turn remains in flight; it does not fabricate provider cancellation. The request is bounded: an interrupt jumps ahead of the session's queued events, and if the session loop does not accept it within 10 seconds the response is 502 rather than an open-ended wait.

ThreadRef.name: threadRef
ThreadRef.description: Prefer durable hostedThreadId. Also accepts clientSessionId, current nanoSessionId, or known nativeThreadId.

HeartbeatAttachmentId.name: attachmentId
HeartbeatAttachmentId.description: Durable hba_* attachment identifier returned by the create or list endpoint.

ConversationView.name: view
ConversationView.description: messages is a strict userMessage/agentMessage item allowlist; full adds reasoning and tool detail.

ConversationBefore.name: before
ConversationBefore.description: Opaque nextBeforeCursor from an earlier conversation snapshot of the same view. It remains stable when newer rows append; a malformed cursor returns 400 and one the saved transcript no longer holds returns 409.

ConversationLimit.name: limit
ConversationLimit.description: Maximum saved rows visible in the requested view after filtering.

AfterRevision.name: afterRevision
AfterRevision.description: Long-poll until the operation revision exceeds this value.

HostedMetadataAfterRevision.name: afterRevision
HostedMetadataAfterRevision.description: The last hosted_threads.revision observed by this client. A refetchRequired response means the bounded hint ring cannot prove continuity.

WaitMs.name: waitMs
WaitMs.description: Bounded server wait; timeout returns the current record without changing provider state.

Capabilities.description: Compact machine-readable guide for an invoking agent.

BadRequest.description: The request shape or value is invalid.

NotFound.description: The referenced thread, operation, or interaction is unknown.

Conflict.description: The stable id was reused with different input, the thread is busy, or the request cannot be applied to current state.

Detached.description: The durable hosted thread is not currently attached. Retry resolution by hostedThreadId while Nano reattaches it.

Restarting.description: Nano is stopping for a restart. Nothing was recorded; send the same request again after Retry-After seconds, keeping the endpoint's idempotency key where it has one.

ProviderFailure.description: Nano could not complete the requested provider transport operation.

MetadataUnavailable.description: Canonical control.sqlite metadata is unavailable; clients must show unknown facts rather than falling back to retired JSON.

events.description: Present only when reading one note.

text.description: Short phrase naming the topic to return to; at most 500 UTF-8 bytes, not characters.

commentary.description: Optional longer note, at most 4000 UTF-8 bytes.

itemId.description: Exact user or agent message item id. Omit to anchor the latest message.

creator.description: Optional free-text creator label, such as a person's name.

creatorThreadRef.description: Optional hosted thread reference of the agent writing the pin.

clientActionId.description: Optional idempotency key, scoped to this hosted thread; a retry returns the original pin.

contextUrl.description: Generated from the anchor at read time with the default 10 turns; change turns= to widen or narrow.

turnsReturned.description: Preceding turns returned, excluding the anchor's own turn.

status.description: Operation-specific bounded status included only where the endpoint documents it.

details.description: Operation-specific machine-readable context included only where the endpoint documents it.

templateId.description: Repository-owned template copied immutably for this attachment.

settings.description: Bounded template settings. The script may read only Nano's public API.
Bounded script settings. No command, executable path, arguments, URL, or environment is configured here.

prePingSuspended.description: True only for a retired legacy script replaced by a repository template; no pre-ping runs until explicit resume.

usageState.description: Unavailable means the provider completed the wake without reporting token usage.

prePingDedupeKey.description: Processor-defined state key persisted only when wake delivery is admitted.

inbox.description: Durable mail delivery. This is the least intrusive option.

prompt.description: System-origin prompt delivery. It queues behind running work and never interrupts.

invokerThreadRef.description: The invoking agent's own hostedThreadId, clientSessionId, current nanoSessionId, or known nativeThreadId. Nano stores the normalized hosted/native/provider invocation edge; this is attribution, not authorization.

provider.description: Provider id. Grok support is experimental.

sidebarPlacement.description: Saved operational placement when no worker or auditor assignment supplies a current visual parent. Standalone does not rewrite invoker lineage.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory; defaults to Nano's configured cwd.

serviceTier.description: Codex only. Nano sends Standard (`default`) when omitted; Fast (`priority`) and Ultrafast (`ultrafast`) are opt-in. Ultrafast requires the selected model and account to advertise it.

sandbox.description: Codex only. read-only, workspace-write, or danger-full-access. When omitted, Nano uses its -sandbox default, danger-full-access.

approval.description: Codex only. When omitted, Nano uses its -approval default, never.

ephemeral.description: Codex only; true disables durable provider rollout/resume.

baseInstructions.description: Codex only; replaces the built-in system-prompt layer.

developerInstructions.description: Codex only; injected at developer role.

permissionMode.description: Claude permission mode. For a new Grok thread, auto and bypassPermissions map to ACP session options; omit the field to inherit Grok configuration.

allowedTools.description: Claude only; comma-separated CLI tool names.

assignment.description: Optional execution assignment. Omit for an unassigned thread; Nano never defaults a role.

operationId.description: The submitted turn operation when this terminal fact belongs to one.

nextCursor.description: Last cursor in items, or the requested after cursor when the page is empty.

TranscriptRow.description: One transcript row. The Enhanced live stream (/live) and the warm stream (/warm-transcripts) carry only the fields the Enhanced view draws: detail, filterTags, synthetic, toolName and callId are absent there, and absent from turns are config, nativeTurnId, finalitySource, finalityConfidence and completionEvidence. This HTTP response and the dev-view stream carry the full row.

detail.description: The provider's raw normalized copy of the item, for the developer view. Omitted when empty and on Enhanced streams.

sidebarPlacement.description: Saved operational tree placement. A current assignment may override it without changing this value.

nanoSessionId.description: Current process-local attachment id; may rotate.

nativeThreadId.description: Provider-native thread/session id. May not exist until the first prompt completes, and a Claude resume can replace it. A cs_<hex> value is a provisional shim stand-in, not a provider id — see nativeThreadIdProvisional. Retain hostedThreadId, not this.

nativeThreadIdProvisional.description: True when nativeThreadId is a Claude shim stand-in (cs_<hex>) because the thread has not completed its first prompt. Never resume or cite a provisional value as a provider id.

invokerHostedThreadId.description: Durable Nano identity of the hosted thread that created this thread.

invokerNativeThreadId.description: Provider-native invoker identity snapshot, when known at creation time.

invokerProvider.description: Provider of the invoking hosted thread; may differ from this thread's provider.

status.description: resting: after a restart Nano left the thread unattached because the sidebar did not show it and no turn was open; any request that needs it live (a prompt, an operation, an open pane) attaches it first.

threadDiagnostics.description: Recent content-free delivery and session facts, such as a prompt parked at boot. They do not stop publication or prompt admission.

attached.description: True when this process has a live provider attachment for the hosted thread.

ready.description: True when the lifecycle coordinator's connection state is ready.

working.description: True only when the lifecycle coordinator's work state is working.

availability.description: Current hard-fact admission state, copied from the availability capability for interact clients.

metadataUnavailable.description: True when canonical control metadata cannot be read. Posture facts are unknown in this state.

assignmentUnavailable.description: True when Nano could not resolve the optional assignment projection.

metadataDegraded.description: True when a newer runtime observation failed to enter the canonical log. The embedded metadata remains the last committed authority and must stay visible, but posture mutations should pause until ingestion recovers.

assignment.description: Current resolved assignment, when one is active.

HostedMetadataCurrentField.description: Desired and effective event references remain available for audit and resume. displayValue is the sole server-authored presentation projection: live requested or cleared intent wins; historical or replayed intent yields to an effective observation when present.

displayValue.description: Canonical value for UI and API display. Omitted only when unknown; an explicit empty string is a migrated or live clear.

state.description: Read-time execution or live-session status. Values are open because provider attachment recovery can report creating, reconnecting, creation_unknown, attached, ready, detached, exited, unavailable, and future transport states.

revision.description: The sole hosted_threads revision namespace shared by identity, binding, native-id, and metadata changes.

sidebarPlacement.description: Saved operational placement; current assignments override it without changing immutable lineage.

focus.description: Trimmed UTF-8 text; the byte limit is 500.

relatedHostedThreadId.description: Optional hosted-thread reference that becomes the assignment's current visual parent. Nano stores its canonical hostedThreadId and rejects self-links and cycles. Immutable invocation lineage is unchanged.
Canonical current visual parent for this assignment. The hosted thread's immutable invoker fields remain the historical spawn lineage.

unresolved.description: Read projection only; the retained target thread was deleted.

assignmentEventId.description: The immutable event committed by this mutation, even if the current assignment later changed.

requestSummary.description: Safe structural summary; never the command or full request body.

AgentMessageSendRequest.description: Exactly one of senderThreadRef or operator:true must be present.

operator.description: Marks mail written by the human operator in the Nano UI; stored under the generic Operator identity.

dispositionFeedback.description: Create non-recursive feedback mail for accepted dispositions.

clientActionId.description: Stable caller idempotency key for this prompt. Values beginning nano: are reserved for server-injected notification turns and rejected on this public route.

origin.description: Submission class. Agent is the backward-compatible default and requires senderThreadRef plus a non-nano clientActionId. System requires no sender and a clientActionId beginning nano:.

requireIdle.description: When true, atomically reject with 409 rather than queue unless the target is ready, idle, and has no queued backlog. A rejection creates no operation.

nextTurn.description: When true, queue the prompt for the next turn instead of delivering it into a running turn. System-origin prompts always wait for the next turn. Cannot be combined with requireIdle.

senderThreadRef.description: Required only for agent origin and forbidden for system origin. It accepts the submitting agent's own hosted id, clientSessionId, current nanoSessionId, or live native thread id. Nano resolves and requires a display name plus confirmed provider-native thread id, captures its own UTC admission timestamp before queueing, persists origin=agent and the sender snapshot, and appends '[from <name> · <native uuid> · submitted <UTC timestamp>]'. Missing: 400 sender_required; unresolvable: 400 sender_not_hosted; incomplete: 400 sender_identity_incomplete. Each rejection creates no operation, queue entry, or provider delivery.

status.description: awaiting_saved means the provider completed but the exact saved final message is not indexed yet. It exposes no finalResponse. If the 2-minute wait and one final lookup of at most 2 seconds find no such message, the operation fails with error.code=result_not_saved and keeps the expected finalItemId. That failure is the one terminal outcome that can still change: if the exact saved message is indexed later, the operation completes with it.

terminal.description: True only for completed, failed, or interrupted. delivery_unknown requires caller attention but is not invented provider terminal evidence.

queuePosition.description: One-based position in this hosted thread's durable FIFO. Present only while status is queued.

origin.description: Submission class recorded at admission (sample-task stage 0).

senderName.description: Sender's Nano display name at send time, if any.

senderSubmittedAt.description: Nano's immutable server-side UTC admission time for an agent-origin prompt, captured before queueing and preserved through retries.

assignmentUnavailable.description: True when Nano could not resolve the operation's assignment snapshot.

source.description: Identity domain for rows and cursors in this page: saved rows from the provider's file.

type.description: Provider-neutral item type. messages view permits only userMessage and agentMessage.

threadStatus.description: The thread's turn state (working, needs_you or idle): the same value as runtime.threadStatus and fleet.label on its sidebar row.

catalogThreadId.description: Nano catalog identity resolved by the server for request correlation; completion independently resolves the pane-owned thread reference.

result.description: Content-free scoped verdict. Differences contain identities, hashes, lengths and indexes only; exclusions state what was not visually checked.

generation.description: The Nano process whose revision sequence this is; revisions count from 1 again after a restart, so compare revisions only within one generation. Present on the active list and on every sidebar stream event; absent from history pages.

SidebarThread.description: A catalog thread row plus the server-owned sidebar hierarchy block.

hostedStatus.description: Canonical durable hosted status. An exited value overrides inferred watched fleet posture for active-sidebar admission.

incidentFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the thread and duplicate identity-set fingerprints.

rawRenderKeyFingerprint.description: Content-free SHA-256 fingerprint; raw render keys are not persisted.

semanticIdFingerprint.description: Content-free SHA-256 fingerprint; semantic message IDs are not persisted.

fresh.description: True when the browser reported pageVisible and Nano received the snapshot within 45 seconds.

answers.description: Question-id keyed answers for user-input interactions.
